name: RNG Gods [alpha]
desc:
Test your luck and roll to unlock 80+ random auras. 
Gain power on each roll and exchange your power for permanent upgrades.
Boost your rolls with elixirs and fruits!

Summon crafting recipes by sacrificing power to the hand.
Craft your auras into powerful vessels!

NOTE: If you're lagging, use a private server! They're free :)

🙏 pray to the rng gods
💎 99% of rollers quit right before they hit it big
